twelve_labs_qa.summary: No Twelve Labs QA result (extension may not have run)

ux_observations.observation: Branding add-on is active but both chrome_show_name and chrome_streamer_name are empty strings. Output has 'AuraFlux' plastered in top bar AND lower-third simultaneously with zero streamer identity.
ux_observations.suggested_change: Block branding add-on from executing when both chrome fields are empty. Require at least one real name or disable branding entirely for this job.

ux_observations.observation: TikTok Clutch template is described as 'single high-energy gaming moment' but source is 333s of IRL basketball fight footage — not gaming content, and 5+ minutes is far too long for a 'single moment' short-form clip.
ux_observations.suggested_change: Route irl_event content to an IRL-specific template. If using TikTok Clutch, enforce a source ceiling around 60-90s or require auto-trim to isolate the actual clutch moment.

ux_observations.observation: Portrait format applied to what is likely landscape basketball court footage. IRL event videos are typically shot wide; portrait crop will cut off action on both sides.
ux_observations.suggested_change: Add content-type-aware format validation. Flag irl_event sources for manual crop review or default to landscape with letterboxing option.

ux_observations.observation: Twelve Labs QA shows 'no result (extension did not run)' — content moderation and moment detection completely skipped on a video containing physical violence.
ux_observations.suggested_change: Make Twelve Labs QA mandatory for irl_event content types. Block staging if QA extension fails to execute.

ux_observations.observation: This is AdinRoss content repackaged with AuraFlux branding and no attribution. Posting this creates DMCA risk and looks like content theft, not original creator work.
ux_observations.suggested_change: Detect when source creator differs from output account. Require explicit 'repost/curation' mode with proper attribution overlay or block job.

ux_observations.observation: Captions add-on activated on IRL fight footage where audio is likely crowd noise, crosstalk, and profanity — captions will be garbage or flag platform violations.
ux_observations.suggested_change: Add content-type filter: skip auto-captions for irl_event unless manually confirmed. Or run profanity filter post-caption before baking in.

twelve_labs_qa.summary: No Twelve Labs QA result (extension may not have run)

ux_observations.observation: Branding add-on is active but both chrome_show_name and chrome_streamer_name are empty strings. Output has 'AuraFlux' stamped in top bar AND lower-third simultaneously — reads as platform watermark spam, not creator branding.
ux_observations.suggested_change: Block render when branding=true but chrome_name fields are empty. Require at least one of show_name or streamer_name to be non-empty before allowing branding add-on activation.

ux_observations.observation: Job status is 'failed' but output URL was still generated and passed to QA. Twelve Labs QA shows 'no result (extension did not run)' — failed jobs should not reach QA review stage.
ux_observations.suggested_change: Add pipeline gate: if job.status === 'failed', halt before QA dispatch and route to error triage instead. Investigate why output URL exists for a failed job.

ux_observations.observation: 380s gaming_reaction clip is within template bounds (300–3600s) but sits at the extreme low end for 'YouTube Deep Dive' which implies substantial long-form content. A 6-minute reaction clip is more suited to 'YouTube Highlights' than a 'Deep Dive' format.
ux_observations.suggested_change: Add soft warning when source duration is <600s for deep_dive template. Suggest alternative template or prompt user to confirm intent.

ux_observations.observation: Twelve Labs QA extension did not run despite being in the expected pipeline for longform YouTube content. No visual/audio quality validation occurred before this output reached review.
ux_observations.suggested_change: Make Twelve Labs QA mandatory for longform template outputs. If extension fails to execute, block QA submission and log extension failure reason.

ux_observations.observation: Six add-ons stacked including colorGrade and effects on a reaction clip where the streamer's face-cam authenticity matters. Over-processing risks making output look artificial.
ux_observations.suggested_change: For content_type 'gaming_reaction', default colorGrade and effects to minimal/off. Let user explicitly opt-in rather than auto-stack.

ux_observations.observation: No streamer would post this: job failed, no QA validation, AuraFlux branding plastered everywhere instead of creator identity, and we have no confirmation captions or audio were actually applied correctly.
ux_observations.suggested_change: This output should never have reached review. Implement pre-QA checklist: job.status === 'completed' AND branding_valid AND twelve_labs_passed before human review.
